description: detaxizer, with --generate-downstream-samplesheets, writes downstream_samplesheets/mag-pe.csv for its filtered paired-end reads, in the column layout of mag 3.x, and mag-se.csv for samples without a second short-read file, which mag cannot take in the same run: a run with any fails this handoff instead of leaving them out; each sample gets its own group and its short reads the ILLUMINA platform detaxizer documents for them. Different samples are not pooled for binning or assembly; use an inline handoff to supply study-specific pooling groups. detaxizer records no long-read platform, and mag chooses its long-read preprocessing and assembler mode by it: samples with long reads are refused until an inline handoff sets long_reads_platform (OXFORD_NANOPORE, OXFORD_NANOPORE_HQ, PACBIO_CLR or PACBIO_HIFI) for the data.
